issues.title: Flat on the bed
issues.message: The part has a flat bottom, but its weight sits outside that footprint, so it may tip over as it gets taller.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so a wider face is on the bottom, or widen the base.

issues.title: 1 mm bottom chamfer
issues.message: Recommend adding 1mm chamfer to the base of all parts for maximum reliability and highest tolerance.

issues.title: Potential Excessive Support
issues.message: Estimated support is about 384% of the part's volume (173.8 cm³ of support for 45.3 cm³ of part). Highlighted areas overhang 35° or less from horizontal.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part to reduce overhangs, add chamfers under overhangs, or split it into pieces that print flat.

issues.title: Requires Support
issues.message: About 7425 mm² of overhangs (35° or less from horizontal) will need support. Highlighted areas show where.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so fewer surfaces face downward, or add chamfers under overhangs.

issues.title: Flat on the bed
issues.message: Nothing on the bottom of this part sits flat on the print bed — it is rounded or tilted. It will need supports and may wobble or detach while printing.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so its largest flat face is on the bottom, or add a flat base before exporting.

issues.title: Potential Excessive Support
issues.message: Estimated support is about 64% of the part's volume (4.4 cm³ of support for 6.9 cm³ of part). Highlighted areas overhang 35° or less from horizontal.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part to reduce overhangs, add chamfers under overhangs, or split it into pieces that print flat.

issues.title: Requires Support
issues.message: About 649 mm² of overhangs (35° or less from horizontal) will need support. Highlighted areas show where.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so fewer surfaces face downward, or add chamfers under overhangs.
